newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank checks zloty, no confirmed action.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank checks zloty, no confirmed action.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland has repeatedly checked zloty rates in morning Thursday trade, but has so far not intervened on the forex market, dealers said.
The zloty has firmed more than half a percent against the basket within the last 20 minutes amid rumours that the NBP started selling dollars on the market.
At 0835 GMT the zloty was at -3.46/-4.03 percent from parity, up from opening at -3.80/-4.53 percent and intraday lows around -4.3 percent at bid.
It was at 3.4800/900 to the dollar against opening at 3.5000/200 and unchanged at 1.9470/640 to the mark.
Dealers said a large client order may have also caused the zloty to jump half a percent this morning.

"There was no need for the NBP to intervene. It may have been a client order, as it really doesn't take much to move the zloty on this volatile market," said Malgorzata Sawicka, dealer at Bank Handlowy SA. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
